### B23. Version — Description · max 4000
Paste into every localization the listing has: App Review checks the Terms and Privacy links in each one.
<!-- from: docs/store/APP_STORE_LISTING.md, docs/rules/PREMIUM_RULES.md, docs/status/DONE_WORK.md -->
```text
A calm, private migraine tracker for people whose attacks follow the weather - especially a falling barometric pressure.

LOG IN THREE TAPS
• Intensity, where it hurts on a 3D head, medication. Done.
• Works fully offline - no signal needed.
• A running attack gets a live timer on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
• Note when a dose was taken and when the pain eased.

SEE YOUR WEATHER LINK
• Every attack is paired with the pressure at that moment.
• Attacks sit on the pressure curve at the hour they started.
• See what share of your attacks lined up with rapid pressure drops.
• A week of pressure forecast and a risk outlook for the days ahead.

A 30-SECOND DAILY CHECK-IN
• Sleep, stress, water, screen time and more - attack days and quiet days alike.
• Builds a trigger and protector map from your own history.
• Feeds a rule-based risk score, with weights you can read.
• MIDAS questionnaire, scored.

ONE TAP FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Widget with the log button, this week's count and the latest pressure.
• Siri opens the log flow or the daily check-in.

BUILT FOR SENSITIVE EYES
• Dark by default. No harsh white screens, no flashing.
• Designed for photophobia.

YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE
• Local-first: your history lives on your phone.
• Nothing is uploaded unless you choose to sign in and sync.
• No ads, no tracking.
• Coarse (~city-scale) location only, and only while using the app.
• Apple Health sleep, steps and cycle are read on-device.
• Delete everything - account included - from Settings.

FREE, WITHOUT LIMITS
• Full history, every chart, the forecast, every correlation, the trigger map, the risk score and MIDAS.
• Unlimited attacks, medications and reminders.
• Seven languages.

PREMIUM
• Pressure-drop push alerts, and a second push as the fall begins.
• Export: JSON, CSV and a PDF doctor report.
• Monthly, yearly with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
• Premium Monthly and Premium Yearly (7-day free trial) are auto-renewable subscriptions.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• A subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of that period.
• Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
• Privacy Policy: https://damhongduc.github.io/personal_work_space/apps/baro-ease/privacy_policy/

Medical disclaimer: BaroEase is a self-tracking tool and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Always consult a qualified clinician.
```

### B31. App Review — Notes · max 4000
<!-- from: docs/store/APP_STORE_LISTING.md, docs/rules/PREMIUM_RULES.md -->
```text
- The app is fully functional without an account: log attacks, view history, insights and the forecast with no sign-in.
- Premium covers only pressure-drop push alerts and the Export screen (JSON, CSV, PDF report). Everything else is free.
- Sign in with Apple is offered alongside Google (4.8) and upgrades the anonymous account in place.
- Account deletion: Account screen > Delete account (5.1.1(v)). It deletes the account, its synced records and this device's copy.
- Location is requested While Using at reduced accuracy, only for optional pressure alerts. Denying it leaves the rest of the app usable.
- Health access (sleep, steps, cycle) is optional and read-only; the app works without it.
- The 3D head model is a CC BY 3.0 scan, attributed on the About screen.
```

### B32. Version — What's New · max 4000
<!-- from: git log 113abbf4..1a1b026d (1.2.0 → 1.3.0), docs/rules/PREMIUM_RULES.md -->
```text
More of BaroEase is free, and the app has a new look.

- Everything is now free except pressure-drop push alerts and export: full history, every chart, the forecast, every correlation, the risk score and MIDAS, with unlimited attacks, medications and reminders.
- Redesigned home, log flow, attack clock and history.
- A new risk forecast card, with its own detail screen.
- A pressure outlook card, and the pressure at the moment you saved an attack.
- Type an attack's duration in hours and minutes.
- One sheet holds every filter, for History and medications.
- A one-time lifetime purchase sits beside monthly and yearly.
- Fixes and polish throughout.
```
